## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2009-07-28: First filing of the form-of TRA (Reorganizations) as Exhibit 10.4 to S-1/A No. 4
- 2009-08-17: Executed TRA (Reorganizations) covering Pre-IPO Basis Adjustments arising from the IPO reorganization transactions, beneficiaries H&F ITR Holdco, GA ITR Holdco, and GA-H&F ITR Holdco

#### Blackstone going-private merger and TRA amendment-restatement

- 2011-11-02: Going-private merger consummated; Amended and Restated TRA (Reorganizations) executed substituting Beagle Parent LLC for GA ITR Holdco
- 2012-07-20: A&R TRA (Reorganizations) text first filed on EDGAR as Exhibit 10.6 to Beagle Parent / Emdeon S-4

#### McKesson JV transition (TRA persists)

- 2016-07-05: 8-K announcing McKesson JV; this TRA defined as one of three "Existing Echo TRAs" that continue post-close
- 2017-01-26: Last filing in directory; aggregate $355.7M expected total remaining payments across three TRAs

## Explanation

This TRA is the Pre-IPO-reorganization sister of the Exchanges TRA: same parties (Emdeon plus the H&F and GA vehicles), same 85% rate, and the same November 2011 Amended and Restated substitution of Beagle Parent LLC for GA ITR Holdco at the Blackstone going-private merger close. The economic distinction from the Exchanges TRA is the covered tax attribute: Pre-IPO Basis Adjustments from the IPO-time reorganization transactions, rather than future Section 754 step-ups on later LLC-unit exchanges. The McKesson JV preserved this TRA at the CHH level when it closed March 1, 2017. Post-January 2017 lifecycle (including the October 3, 2022 termination at the UnitedHealth merger) is captured under successor CIK 0001756497. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record and the cross-reference to `../change-healthcare-inc_0001756497/`.
